verses.en: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.
verses.pt: Eis aqui o meu servo, a quem sustenho; o meu escolhido, em quem se compraz a minha alma; pus o meu espírito sobre ele. ele trará justiça às nações.
verses.en_web: “Behold, my servant, whom I uphold; my chosen, in whom my soul delights— I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring justice to the nations.
verses.en_bbe: See my servant, whom I am supporting, my loved one, in whom I take delight: I have put my spirit on him; he will give the knowledge of the true God to the nations.

verses.en: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.
verses.pt: Não clamará, não se exaltará, nem fará ouvir a sua voz na rua.
verses.en_web: He will not shout, nor raise his voice, nor cause it to be heard in the street.
verses.en_bbe: He will make no cry, his voice will not be loud: his words will not come to men's ears in the streets.

verses.en: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
verses.pt: A cana trilhada, não a quebrará, nem apagará o pavio que fumega; em verdade trará a justiça;
verses.en_web: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice.
verses.en_bbe: He will not let a crushed stem be quite broken, and he will not let a feebly burning light be put out: he will go on sending out the true word to the peoples.

verses.en: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.
verses.pt: não faltará nem será quebrantado, até que ponha na terra a justiça; e as ilhas aguardarão a sua lei.
verses.en_web: He will not fail nor be discouraged, until he has set justice in the earth, and the islands will wait for his law.”
verses.en_bbe: His light will not be put out, and he will not be crushed, till he has given the knowledge of the true God to the earth, and the sea-lands will be waiting for his teaching.

verses.en: Thus saith God the LORD, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:
verses.pt: Assim diz Deus, o Senhor, que criou os céus e os desenrolou, e estendeu a terra e o que dela procede; que dá a respiração ao povo que nela está, e o espírito aos que andam nela.
verses.en_web: Thus says God Yahweh, he who created the heavens and stretched them out, he who spread out the earth and that which comes out of it, he who gives breath to its people and spirit to those who walk in it.
verses.en_bbe: God the Lord, even he who made the heavens, measuring them out on high; stretching out the earth, and giving its produce; he who gives breath to the people on it, and life to those who go about on it, says:

verses.en: I the LORD have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;
verses.pt: Eu o Senhor te chamei em justiça; tomei-te pela mão, e te guardei; e te dei por pacto ao povo, e para luz das nações;
verses.en_web: “I, Yahweh, have called you in righteousness, and will hold your hand, and will keep you, and make you a covenant for the people, as a light for the nations;
verses.en_bbe: I the Lord have made you the vessel of my purpose, I have taken you by the hand, and kept you safe, and I have given you to be an agreement to the people, and a light to the nations:

verses.en: To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.
verses.pt: para abrir os olhos dos cegos, para tirar da prisão os presos, e do cárcere os que jazem em trevas.
verses.en_web: to open the blind eyes, to bring the prisoners out of the dungeon, and those who sit in darkness out of the prison.
verses.en_bbe: To give eyes to the blind, to make free the prisoners from the prison, to let out those who are shut up in the dark.

verses.en: I am the LORD: that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.
verses.pt: Eu sou o Senhor; este é o meu nome; a minha glória, pois, a outrem não a darei, nem o meu louvor às imagens esculpidas.
verses.en_web: “I am Yahweh. That is my name. I will not give my glory to another, nor my praise to engraved images.
verses.en_bbe: I am the Lord; that is my name: I will not give my glory to another, or my praise to pictured images.

verses.en: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.
verses.pt: Eis que as primeiras coisas já se realizaram, e novas coisas eu vos anuncio; antes que venham à luz, vo-las faço ouvir.
verses.en_web: Behold, the former things have happened, and I declare new things. I tell you about them before they come up.”
verses.en_bbe: See, the things said before have come about, and now I give word of new things: before they come I give you news of them.

verses.en: Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.pt: Cantai ao Senhor um cântico novo, e o seu louvor desde a extremidade da terra, vós, os que navegais pelo mar, e tudo quanto há nele, vós ilhas, e os vossos habitantes.
verses.en_web: Sing to Yahweh a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the islands and their inhabitants.
verses.en_bbe: Make a new song to the Lord, and let his praise be sounded from the end of the earth; you who go down to the sea, and everything in it, the sea-lands and their people.

verses.en: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.
verses.pt: Alcem a voz o deserto e as suas cidades, com as aldeias que Quedar habita; exultem os que habitam nos penhascos, e clamem do cume dos montes.
verses.en_web: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices, with the villages that Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of Sela sing. Let them shout from the top of the mountains!
verses.en_bbe: Let the waste land and its flocks be glad, the tent-circles of Kedar; let the people of the rock give a glad cry, from the top of the mountains let them make a sound of joy.

verses.en: Let them give glory unto the LORD, and declare his praise in the islands.
verses.pt: Dêem glória ao Senhor, e anunciem nas ilhas o seu louvor.
verses.en_web: Let them give glory to Yahweh, and declare his praise in the islands.
verses.en_bbe: Let them give glory to the Lord, sounding his praise in the sea-lands.

verses.en: The LORD shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.
verses.pt: O Senhor sai como um valente, como homem de guerra desperta o zelo; clamará, e fará grande ruído, e mostrar-se-á valente contra os seus inimigos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will go out like a mighty man. He will stir up zeal like a man of war. He will raise a war cry. Yes, he will shout aloud. He will triumph over his enemies.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will go out as a man of war, he will be moved to wrath like a fighting-man: his voice will be strong, he will give a loud cry; he will go against his attackers like a man of war.

verses.en: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself: now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.
verses.pt: Por muito tempo me calei; estive em silêncio, e me contive; mas agora darei gritos como a que está de parto, arfando e arquejando.
verses.en_web: “I have been silent a long time. I have been quiet and restrained myself. Now I will cry out like a travailing woman. I will both gasp and pant.
verses.en_bbe: I have long been quiet, I have kept myself in and done nothing: now I will make sounds of pain like a woman in childbirth, breathing hard and quickly.

verses.en: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.
verses.pt: Os montes e outeiros tornarei em deserto, e toda a sua erva farei secar; e tornarei os rios em ilhas, e secarei as lagoas.
verses.en_web: I will destroy mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs. I will make the rivers islands, and will dry up the pools.
verses.en_bbe: I will make waste mountains and hills, drying up all their plants; and I will make rivers dry, and pools dry land.

verses.en: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.
verses.pt: E guiarei os cegos por um caminho que não conhecem; fá-los- ei caminhar por veredas que não têm conhecido; tornarei as trevas em luz perante eles, e aplanados os caminhos escabrosos. Estas coisas lhes farei; e não os desampararei.
verses.en_web: I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know. I will lead them in paths that they don’t know. I will make darkness light before them, and crooked places straight. I will do these things, and I will not forsake them.
verses.en_bbe: And I will take the blind by a way of which they had no knowledge, guiding them by roads strange to them: I will make the dark places light before them, and the rough places level. These things will I do and will not give them up.

verses.en: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye are our gods.
verses.pt: Tornados para trás e cobertos de vergonha serão os que confiam em imagens esculpidas, que dizem às imagens de fundição: Vós sois nossos deuses.
verses.en_web: “Those who trust in engraved images, who tell molten images, ‘You are our gods’ will be turned back. They will be utterly disappointed.
verses.en_bbe: They will be turned back and be greatly shamed who put their hope in pictured images, who say to metal images, You are our gods.

verses.en: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.
verses.pt: Surdos, ouvi; e vós, cegos, olhai, para que possais ver.
verses.en_web: “Hear, you deaf, and look, you blind, that you may see.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear, you whose ears are shut; and let your eyes be open, you blind, so that you may see.

verses.en: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent? who is blind as he that is perfect, and blind as the LORD’S servant?
verses.pt: Quem é cego, senão o meu servo, ou surdo como o meu mensageiro, que envio? e quem é cego como o meu dedicado, e cego como o servo do Senhor?
verses.en_web: Who is blind, but my servant? Or who is as deaf as my messenger whom I send? Who is as blind as he who is at peace, and as blind as Yahweh’s servant?
verses.en_bbe: Who is blind, but my servant? who has his ears stopped, but he whom I send? who is blind as my true one, or who has his ears shut like the Lord's servant?

verses.en: Seeing many things, but thou observest not; opening the ears, but he heareth not.
verses.pt: Tu vês muitas coisas, mas não as guardas; ainda que ele tenha os ouvidos abertos, nada ouve.
verses.en_web: You see many things, but don’t observe. His ears are open, but he doesn’t listen.
verses.en_bbe: Seeing much, but keeping nothing in mind; his ears are open, but there is no hearing.

verses.en: The LORD is well pleased for his righteousness’ sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable.
verses.pt: Foi do agrado do Senhor, por amor da sua justiça, engrandecer a lei e torná-la gloriosa.
verses.en_web: It pleased Yahweh, for his righteousness’ sake, to magnify the law, and make it honorable.
verses.en_bbe: It was the Lord's pleasure, because of his righteousness, to make the teaching great and give it honour.

verses.en: But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.
verses.pt: Mas este é um povo roubado e saqueado; todos estão enlaçados em cavernas, e escondidos nas casas dos cárceres; são postos por presa, e ninguém há que os livre; por despojo, e ninguém diz: Restitui.
verses.en_web: But this is a robbed and plundered people. All of them are snared in holes, and they are hidden in prisons. They have become captives, and no one delivers; and a plunder, and no one says, ‘Restore them!’
verses.en_bbe: But this is a people whose property has been taken away from them by force; they are all taken in holes, and shut up in prisons: they are made prisoners, and no one makes them free; they are taken by force and no one says, Give them back.

verses.en: Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?
verses.pt: Quem há entre vós que a isso dará ouvidos? que atenderá e ouvirá doravante?
verses.en_web: Who is there among you who will give ear to this? Who will listen and hear for the time to come?
verses.en_bbe: Who is there among you who will give ear to this? who will give attention to it for the time to come?

verses.en: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the LORD, he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.
verses.pt: Quem entregou Jacó por despojo, e Israel aos roubadores? porventura não foi o Senhor, aquele contra quem pecamos, e em cujos caminhos eles não queriam andar, e cuja lei não queriam observar?
verses.en_web: Who gave Jacob as plunder, and Israel to the robbers? Didn’t Yahweh, he against whom we have sinned? For they would not walk in his ways, and they disobeyed his law.
verses.en_bbe: Who gave up Jacob to those who took away his goods, and Israel to his attackers? Did not the Lord? he against whom they did wrong, and in whose ways they would not go, turning away from his teaching.

verses.en: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.
verses.pt: Pelo que o Senhor derramou sobre Israel a indignação da sua ira, e a violência da guerra; isso lhe ateou fogo ao redor; contudo ele não o percebeu; e o queimou; contudo ele não se compenetrou disso.
verses.en_web: Therefore he poured the fierceness of his anger on him, and the strength of battle; and it set him on fire all around, but he didn’t know; and it burned him, but he didn’t take it to heart.”
verses.en_bbe: For this reason he let loose on him the heat of his wrath, and his strength was like a flame; and it put fire round about him, but he did not see it; he was burned, but did not take it to heart.
